entries.subject: DAMIT 157: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-157.txt. Model 157, version 2007-02-27, pole (95°, 68°), period 3.968198 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI thermal diameter as an alternative scale
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — retained for comparison; the documented physical calibration supplies the selected scale. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 43.17 ± 0.67 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 125 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.
entries.revisitWhen: A source-specific comparison with the selected shape and physical calibration justifies changing the adopted scale.

entries.subject: Hanuš et al. (2018), Icarus 309, 297–337
entries.finding: [Hanuš et al. (2018), Icarus 309, 297–337](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1803.06116) — retained primary publication; see the body-specific selection and calibration above.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Ďurech2007 is the actual published collaboration-network shape source. Hanuš2018 TableA.3 uses its pole(95,68), period3.96820 h, QF3 and VS-TPM volume-equivalent diameter51.1±2.1 km. Only this uniform size transfer is applied to nominal DAMIT157. The alternative pole(280,74) has its own50.1±1.3 km fit and remains possible; the varied-model ensemble does not establish byte-identical local terrain. Alternative archive solutions: model 158, pole ['280', '74'], [Model 158](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/158) The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 158: pole (280°, 74°), 3.968199 h, version 2007-02-27. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown size Display reference radius "25.55 km (size-calibrated model)" (hanus-2018-thermophysical-models) differs from the NEOWISE V2.0 neowise_mainbelt.csv record 93 (Masiero et al. 2014) diameter 48.418 ± 0.533 km (NEOWISE, NEATM); the shown value is kept.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
